title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Alx(TiZrTa0.7NbMo) refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum-arc melting process with high-purity argon protection, repeatedly smelted at 450-500A current, then vacuum-sealed in quartz tubes and annealed at 1000°C for 12h with slow cooling (10°C/min)
